description: Use this when you need the result of one European Parliament roll-call vote: totals, the split by political group and by country, the dossier it belongs to, and optionally how individual MEPs voted. Takes a vote id from list_votes, get_dossier or get_mep (or an epvotes.com/votes/<id> url). Set members to a group (e.g. "EPP", "S&D") or a country code (e.g. "DE", "FRA") to list those MEPs' votes.

members.description: Optional: list individual MEP votes for one political group or one country. "all" lists every MEP.

name: get_vote
title: Get a roll-call vote
